summary: The CriminalRecordsCheck module is a user control within the HSPnet Enrollment subsystem for displaying, editing, and maintaining students' criminal record check (CRC) information. It supports filtering, sorting, paging, bulk actions, in-grid editing, and integrates with role-based access and workflow mechanisms.
purpose: To manage, validate, and update criminal records check details for students enrolled in courses/cohorts, supporting both individual and bulk update workflows while ensuring access control and auditability.

workflows.name: View and Filter CRC Records
steps: User sets filters (section, action, campus, keyword, show grad, show inactive, show waived, comments).
System queries and displays a paginated list of students matching the criteria with CRC status columns.
User can toggle paging or search for specific students.

workflows.name: Edit Single CRC Record
steps: User clicks edit for a specific student.
System loads CRC edit grid for the student, showing editable fields: status, date, notes.
System validates, updates record, refreshes list and UI.

workflows.name: Bulk Edit/Save CRC Records
steps: User clicks edit all; system transitions grid to multi-edit mode.
User updates CRC status for multiple students.
System iterates through edited rows, validates, and updates each record.
If success, refresh main grid and update UI.

workflows.name: Waive CRC Requirement
steps: User invokes 'Unwaive' or waives requirement for a student.
System updates the CRC waived status and disables other actions for the row if waived.

workflows.name: Reactivate/Remove Student from Cohort
steps: System prompts for confirmation, performs the action, and updates grid.

business_rules: Read-only mode disables editing and hides edit/all controls.
Rows are disabled for editing if the student is graduated, inactive, waived, or if enrollment prerequisites/worksite exist.
Only users with appropriate permissions (StudentMaint, SystemAdministrator) have edit access.
Waived CRC disables all other row actions.
'Save All' and 'Cancel' only appear if more than 14 records (for scrolling).
validations: Date values are parsed and validated during edit.
Dropdowns for CRC status are only active for enabled rows.
Null or missing session cancels data source operations.
On save, status/date/notes cannot be left empty (implied by UI requirements).
calculations: Determining whether a row or action is disabled based on student status and role.
Paging and visibility toggling based on user action and record count.
conditions: Show/hide edit and save controls depending on read-only state.
Show/hide CRC actions depending on waived status or student graduation/inactive.
Attach client-side handlers (JavaScript) for 'Select All', 'Select None', and dirty tracking.
system_behavior: Binds and refreshes grids after any update or filter change.
Registers client-side scripts for field variable registration after AJAX postbacks.
Populates dropdowns and controls based on context (filled on Page_Load, filter, or row events).
Uses modal popups for single record editing.
Handles asynchronous updates (partial page updates via UpdatePanel).
dependencies: Grid control utilities (HideButtons, SetupEditButton, SetupReactivateButton, DisableEditFields, etc.)
DataLayer.Enrollment and Codes.CodeSearch for data access.
exceptions: Missing or invalid session results in cancelled data operations.
Database errors trigger user session cache and redirect to error handling or fallback screens.
Invalid/dirty tracking may skip updating specific rows.
content_gaps: No documentation for user-facing validation messages or detailed error handling.
No explicit documentation of role definitions or security beyond code structure.
No description of external integration or export features, if any.
